windows.command: py -3.11 -m venv .venv; .\.venv\Scripts\python -m pip install --upgrade pip; .\.venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt

linux.command: python3.11 -m venv .venv && ./.venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && ./.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt

osx.command: python3.11 -m venv .venv && ./.venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && ./.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt

tasks.label: GCP: login (local credentials for GCS)
tasks.command: gcloud auth login; gcloud auth application-default login; gcloud config set project consumption-web

tasks.label: Cloud Run: deploy to PRODUCTION
tasks.command: gcloud run deploy consumption-web --source . --project consumption-web --region europe-north1 --allow-unauthenticated --memory 2Gi --cpu 1 --timeout 600 --concurrency 1

tasks.label: Cloud Run: show current env vars
tasks.command: gcloud run services describe consumption-web --project consumption-web --region europe-north1 --format="yaml(spec.template.spec.containers[0].env)"

tasks.label: Cloud Run: list revisions
tasks.command: gcloud run revisions list --service consumption-web --project consumption-web --region europe-north1
